properties.name: 21 Bournville Road (Home Base)
properties.description: Our peaceful home base in scenic Rathmines on the western shores of Lake Macquarie. Perfect launchpad for lake adventures, vineyard day-trips, and coastal exploring.

Quick access to Toronto and M1 motorway

properties.name: Rathmines Park & WWII Catalina Base
properties.address: Dorrington Rd & Stilling St, Rathmines NSW 2283
properties.description: The largest flying boat base in the Southern Hemisphere during WWII. Today it is a stunning 60-hectare recreational park with historic hangars, slipways, playgrounds, and shared paths.
properties.personal_recommendation: Our favorite sunrise and evening stroll! Walk down the concrete flying boat slipways into the lake where the giant Catalina seaplanes took off. Great local coffee van often parked on weekends.
properties.nsw_seed_layer: State Heritage Register / Coastal Open Space
properties.image_caption: Historic RAAF PBY Catalina Flying Boat identical to those stationed at Rathmines

properties.personal_recommendation: Great spot for an easy Friday dinner or Sunday barefoot bowls with panoramic sunset views over Catalina Bay. The bistro schnitzels and seafood basket are excellent value.
